standard_prerequisites.name: Boundedness of the geometric fibres of a surjective etale cover, and the stratification where the cover becomes finite of the minimal degree
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Decent Spaces, labels decent-spaces-lemma-bounded-fibres (invoked at proof line 3510) and decent-spaces-lemma-quasi-compact-reasonable-stratification (invoked at proof line 3514)
standard_prerequisites.use: They produce an integer $d$ bounding the number of geometric fibre points of the surjective etale cover $W \to X$, and, for $d$ minimal, a nonempty open $U \subset X$ over which the cover is finite etale of degree $d$.

standard_prerequisites.name: The diagonal of a separated etale morphism is an open and closed immersion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, labels spaces-morphisms-lemma-etale-unramified and spaces-morphisms-lemma-diagonal-unramified-morphism (invoked at proof lines 3524 and 3525)
standard_prerequisites.use: It makes the diagonals open and closed subschemes of the $d$-fold fibre product, hence the complement $V$ of all diagonals is a quasi-compact scheme.

standard_prerequisites.name: Every affine scheme of finite type embeds as an open subscheme of an H-projective scheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, labels morphisms-lemma-quasi-affine-finite-type-over-S and morphisms-lemma-H-quasi-projective-open-H-projective (invoked at proof lines 3533 and 3534)
standard_prerequisites.use: It provides the open immersion $W \subset Y$ with $Y$ H-projective over $A$ into which the construction is placed.

standard_prerequisites.name: The refined valuative criterion for universal closedness, and lifting points through the flat cover after extending the valuation ring
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms of Spaces, labels spaces-morphisms-lemma-refined-valuative-criterion-universally-closed (invoked at proof line 3576) and spaces-morphisms-lemma-lift-valuation-ring-through-flat-morphism (invoked at proof line 3596)
standard_prerequisites.use: The criterion reduces properness of $X' \to X$ to lifting valuation ring diagrams, and the lifting lemma supplies $w : \Spec(R) \to W$ over $\Spec(R) \to X$ after extending $R$.

standard_prerequisites.name: The valuative criterion of properness for the projective morphisms $g_i$
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Morphisms, label morphisms-lemma-locally-projective-proper and Schemes, label schemes-proposition-characterize-universally-closed (invoked at proof lines 3606-3608)
standard_prerequisites.use: They lift $w$ to a morphism $z : \Spec(R) \to Z$ whose image lands in $g_i^{-1}(W) \subset X'$, completing the verification of the claim.

core_obligations: Choose a surjective etale morphism $W \to X$ with $W$ affine, bound the number of points of its geometric fibres by a minimal $d$, and find a nonempty open $U \subset X$ over which the cover is finite etale of degree $d$ (proof lines 3506-3514).

Form the complement $V$ of all diagonals in the $d$-fold fibre product $W \times_X \ldots \times_X W$, note that it is quasi-compact because the diagonals are open and closed, embed $W$ into an H-projective $Y$ and take the scheme theoretic image $Z$ of $V$ in $Y \times_A \ldots \times_A Y$, with $V \to Z$ an open immersion and projective projections $g_i$ (proof lines 3515-3548).

Define $X' = \bigcup g_i^{-1}(W) \subset Z$, glue the morphisms $g_i^{-1}(W) \to W \to X$ into a morphism $X' \to X$ (they agree over $V$ and hence on the intersections), and state the claim that it is proper (proof lines 3549-3558).

Assuming the claim, conclude by induction on $d$: $X'$ is H-quasi-projective over $\Spec(A)$ and its image contains $U$, while the reduced complement $T = X \setminus U$ has a proper surjective cover $T' \to T$ by induction, so that $X' \amalg T' \to X$ is proper surjective (proof lines 3560-3571).

Prove the claim with the refined valuative criterion: $X' \to X$ is separated of finite type and conditions (1)-(3) hold; given a valuation ring diagram, lift $\Spec(R) \to X$ to $w : \Spec(R) \to W$ after possibly extending $R$, match $w|_{\Spec(K)}$ with one of the $d$ pairwise distinct points, and lift $w$ along the projective $g_i$ to $z : \Spec(R) \to Z$ with image in $X'$ (proof lines 3573-3611).
proof_roadmap: The surjective etale cover, the bound $d$ and the open $U$ where it is finite of degree $d$ (proof lines 3506-3514).
The complement of the diagonals, the scheme theoretic image $Z$ and the projections $g_i$ (proof lines 3515-3548).
Construction and gluing of $X' \to X$, and the claim (proof lines 3549-3558).
Induction on $d$ from the claim (proof lines 3560-3571).
Proof of the claim by the refined valuative criterion (proof lines 3573-3611).
difficulty_reason: The lemma, the weak Chow lemma for algebraic spaces, produces a proper surjective morphism from an H-quasi-projective scheme onto a separated finite type algebraic space over an affine base (statement lines 3497-3503). The proof isolates an open where a surjective etale cover is finite of minimal degree, builds the complement of the diagonals in a fibre product, resolves it inside a product of H-projective schemes, glues the resulting pieces into a candidate cover, finishes by induction on the degree, and verifies properness of the candidate through the refined valuative criterion together with a lifting argument along the projective projections. The construction of the cover and the valuative verification are the substance, so the claim is H2.
